sources.body:
PR 142: Fix Redis connection leak during retry backoff.
reviewer-maya noted: Line 84: We are not closing the orphan socket when exponential backoff triggers a reconnect.
dev-chen pushed commit 4f82a1b calling client.disconnect() in the catch block before sleeping.
reviewer-tom benchmarked flat socket count under simulated packet drop and approved.

retrieved.quote: Line 84: We are not closing the orphan socket when exponential backoff triggers a reconnect.
Commit 4f82a1b explicitly calls client.disconnect() in the catch block before sleeping.
Benchmark shows socket count remains flat under simulated 50% packet drop. LGTM to merge.
